decisions.reason: A hearty bread loaf fits the firm's core bakery assortment, costs little to keep in production alongside existing lines, and one year of results is too little to resolve uncertainty about its value, so the option stays open.

The historic mill tour builds on an existing asset at low marginal cost and supports the brand, but it lies outside the core food business, so there is some risk it is quietly discontinued if demand stays thin.
Sweet pastries are a cheap, flexible line for a bakery and are still visible on the website after the first year, so keeping the option open is better than abandoning it before its value is revealed.
